# Vendor — سورس TRex از TradingView

برای ATR دقیق در **استراتژی**، سورس ipooya را اینجا کپی کنید.

## مراحل

1. https://www.tradingview.com/script/MeOUBz32-ATR-TRex-ipooya/
2. Source code → Open in editor
3. Save as `atr_trex_ipooya_raw.pine`
4. Convert to `library("CommunityTrexAtr")` with exported TR/TH functions
5. Publish on TradingView
6. Import in `market_structure_engine.pine`

Until then, add ipooya indicator directly on chart for display.
